ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds a weekly schedule trigger (Monday 06:00 UTC) to security.yml; sets persist-credentials: false on checkout; makes the critical gate fail closed unless all three scanner SARIF reports exist; rewrites header and install comments. No action added, removed or re-pinned; permissions unchanged; pull_request stays off. Known gap now run weekly: Semgrep (pip) and Trivy (apt) install unpinned latest versions; pinning them is a recorded follow-up triage card. Third-party actions stay SHA-pinned per ADR-012.
